Content.SourceString: 您好，我想分享一下我最近遇到的怪事，你千万别害怕。
Content.LocalizedString: Hello there, I'd like to share something strange that happened to me recently. Don't be scared, okay?

Content.SourceString: 我撞鬼了！
Content.LocalizedString: I saw… a ghost!

Content.SourceString: 是真事！但是他们都不相信我！
Content.LocalizedString: It's true! But nobody believes me!

Content.SourceString: 我相信你
Content.LocalizedString: I believe you

Content.SourceString: 我受过严格的训练，放心。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm a professional. Don't worry.

Content.SourceString: 最近不停地加班加班加班，每次回家的时候，只有路灯照亮我回家的路。
Content.LocalizedString: I've been working overtime nonstop lately. Every time I head home, there's only the streetlight that is with me.

Content.SourceString: 所以第一次看到那个黑影的时候，我还以为是加班太久了，出现幻觉了。
Content.LocalizedString: So when I first saw that dark shadow, I thought I was just hallucinating from working overtime for too long.

Content.SourceString: 唉，加班，唉，幻觉。
Content.LocalizedString: Overtime. Hallucination. Overtime. Hallucination.

Content.SourceString: 欸，你这工作待遇怎么样啊？要加班吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Hey, how are the conditions at your job? Do you have to work overtime?

Content.SourceString: 好像跑题了……
Content.LocalizedString: Seems like we're getting off-topic…

Content.SourceString: 这不是好久都没和人聊天了，唉……这就说回来。
Content.LocalizedString: It's just that I haven't chatted with anyone for so long… Let's get back on topic.

Content.SourceString: 不加班吧，待遇也还行。
Content.LocalizedString: No overtime, and the compensation is pretty decent.

Content.SourceString: 唉，真羡慕。
Content.LocalizedString: Well… I really envy you.

Content.SourceString: 不对，我是来投稿的。
Content.LocalizedString: No, wait. I'm here to make a submission.

Content.SourceString: 加班，狠狠加班。
Content.LocalizedString: Overtime. Brutal. No sleep. No holidays. In the office. At home. Outside. On the table. On the chair. In the toilet. On bus. On train. All the time.

Content.SourceString: 唉，没事，大家都是这样。
Content.LocalizedString: Well… We're all in the same boat.

Content.SourceString: 不聊这个了，越说越难过。
Content.LocalizedString: Let's drop this topic. The more we talk about it, the more depressing it gets.

Content.SourceString: 但那之后几天都很正常，我都快把这事给忘了，但是它又出现了。
Content.LocalizedString: But everything was normal for several days after that. I had almost forgotten about it when it appeared again.

Content.SourceString: 没有脸，很高，就在路灯下，很长的手臂，很长的腿，那绝对不是人！
Content.LocalizedString: No face, incredibly tall, standing right under the streetlight, with long arms and long legs—that was absolutely not human!

Content.SourceString: 那天之后，每一天的晚上，它就站在我家楼下不远处。
Content.LocalizedString: After that day, every single night, it would stand not far from the entrance to my apartment building.

Content.SourceString: 我试过报警，但他们每次来却什么都查不到。
Content.LocalizedString: I tried calling the police, but every time they came, they couldn't find anything.

Content.SourceString: 难道……
Content.LocalizedString: Could it be…

Content.SourceString: 我怀疑是真是加班加太多，都出现幻视了，不行啊，这我要申请工伤。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm pretty sure I've been working too much overtime and now I'm hallucinating. This won't do—I'm filing for worker's compensation.

Content.SourceString: 唉，加班，唉，幻觉。
Content.LocalizedString: Overtime. Hallucination. Overtime. Hallucination.

Content.SourceString: 停。
Content.LocalizedString: Stop.

Content.SourceString: 马上回到正题。
Content.LocalizedString: Let's get back to the main point.

Content.SourceString: 它就站在路灯旁边，也不做什么，我把卧室的窗户封上了，只要睡一觉醒来，白天它就消失了。
Content.LocalizedString: It just stands next to the street lamp, not doing anything. I've sealed up my bedroom window. After I sleep and wake up, it's gone during the day.

Content.SourceString: 直到周末那天下雨，明明还是正午，我还是看见它了。
Content.LocalizedString: Until it rained that weekend. Even though it was still midday, I saw it again.

Content.SourceString: 它就站在我家楼下的那盏路灯边，缓缓抬头看向我。
Content.LocalizedString: It stands by the street lamp below my apartment building, slowly lifting its head to look at me.

Content.SourceString: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！！
Content.LocalizedString: AAAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!!!!!!

OptionText.SourceString: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！！

Content.SourceString: 发生了什么？
Content.LocalizedString: What happened?

Content.SourceString: 受伤了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Are you hurt?

Content.SourceString: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！！
Content.LocalizedString: AAAAAAAAAHHHHHHH!!!!!!

Content.SourceString: 太可怕了，我感觉他越来越近了，总有一天它会找上来的。
Content.LocalizedString: It's terrifying. I feel it getting closer and closer… Someday, it will find me.

Content.SourceString: 但是没有人相信我说的话，他们都不相信！
Content.LocalizedString: But no one believes what I'm saying, none of them believe me!

Content.SourceString: 可怜的我，每天要上班，还睡不好觉。该死的老板，我那单薄的工资条连电费都要交不起了。
Content.LocalizedString: Poor me, having to go to work every day and I can't even get a good night's sleep. Damn boss… my pathetic paycheck can barely cover the electric bill anymore.

Content.SourceString: 电费？
Content.LocalizedString: Electric bill?

Content.SourceString: 这个月电费几乎翻了两倍，别让我找到是谁偷拉我家电线。
Content.LocalizedString: My electric bill nearly doubled this month. God help whoever I catch stealing power from my place.

Content.SourceString: 坏了，我听到老板的脚步声了。
Content.LocalizedString: Crap, I can hear my boss's footsteps.

Content.SourceString: （对方已离线）
Content.LocalizedString: (User is offline)
